notes: CMA-ES space for policies.ctrl_w:CtrlW -- Wu's controller plus our layer.
18 dims. 'init' is omitted everywhere: sbx.tune reads the live PARAMS of the
class, so changing a default here needs no edit to this file.
* forgetting_factor and model_residual_gain -- Wu declares both in
TransferPolicy.DEFAULTS but no line of his code reads them, so a search
dimension would be a constant. They stay in PARAMS for interface parity.
* the four *_enabled flags -- on/off switches, pinned at the measured-best
setting of the ablation, not something to randomise.
* elec_hour_blend -- 1.0 is what the reward derivation gives; the knob is
there for an ablation, not for the search.
standby_minimum and standby_maximum are searched independently; the ranges
do not overlap (289 < 296), so every sample keeps min < max.
comfort_margin is added to the low band edge and subtracted from the high
one, so an upper bound of 0.8 K cannot invert the 3 K comfort window.
precondition_hours only matters when early_preheat_enabled is on (Wu's own
